citations.claim: First violating step: body centre at wall face with 0.2 overlap exceeding 0.15 limit
Body at same height just above wall top, showing grazing corner hit
Body approaching at full speed one step before violation

explanation: Fast body (vx=60) with large dt grazes the top corner of wall (top at y=5.7, face at x=10). Per-step travel ~2.0 requires ~67 substeps yet the corner/edge contact still resolves late: at step 4 the centre reaches the wall face (x~10) at y=6 where the circle overlaps the wall side/top region by 0.20, exceeding the 0.15 allowance. Likely cause is insufficient substep contact resolution / positional correction for high-speed grazing corner impacts.
vision_note: The red ball moves rightward toward a tall thin vertical wall, staying clear of it in steps 1-3. In step 4 it suddenly appears centered on the top tip of the wall, visibly overlapping the corner.
